name: beruang-budget
description: Track money, transactions, and budgets. Per-user data with shortcodes and admin pages.

scripts.build: npm run lint && composer run lint && 10up-toolkit build
scripts.lint: npm run lint-php && npm run lint-js && npm run lint-css
scripts.lint-fix: npm run lint-fix-js && npm run lint-fix-css
scripts.zip: npm run build && composer run test && version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && cd .. && zip -r beruang-budget.$version.zip beruang-budget -x '*/.?*' -x '*node_modules*' -x '*/vendor/*' -x '*/tests/*' -x '*/test-results/*' -x '*/tests/e2e/report/*' -x '*/playwright-report/*' -x '*phpunit.xml.dist' -x '*AGENTS.md' -x '*.code-workspace'
scripts.postversion: sed -i "s/^* Version: .*/ * Version: $npm_package_version/" beruang-budget.php && sed -i "s/define( 'BERUANG_BUDGET_VERSION', '[^']*' )/define( 'BERUANG_BUDGET_VERSION', '$npm_package_version' )/" beruang-budget.php tests/bootstrap.php && sed -i "s/^Stable tag: .*/Stable tag: $npm_package_version/" readme.txt
scripts.lang: npm run make-pot && npm run make-mo
